correctness.rationale: For a simple Hermitian eigenpair, Hu and Hw are independent, and orthonormalization yields three independent complex Gaussian projections. The almost-sure simple-pencil root admits analytic derivatives, exactly solving a standard 2x2 complex-Ginibre inverse ratio. The real Jacobian |det G|^2 and Gaussian determinant moment 2 give the properly normalized 2/pi^2(1+||x||^2)^-3 density; polar integration establishes all sharp tails, and exact orthogonality yields the angle/refined quotient limits. Standalone code cross-checks direct eigensystems including complex coupling. Finite experiments are not the proof.
